def solve_linear(A, b):
    n = len(A)
    # Augment
    M = [A[i][:] + [b[i]] for i in range(n)]
    
    # Forward elimination
    for i in range(n):
        # Find pivot
        max_row = i
        for r in range(i+1, n):
            if abs(M[r][i]) > abs(M[max_row][i]):
                max_row = r
        M[i], M[max_row] = M[max_row], M[i]
        
        # Make sure diagonal is non-zero
        if abs(M[i][i]) < 1e-10:
            continue

            factor = M[r][i] / M[i][i]
            for c in range(i, n+1):
                M[r][c] -= factor * M[i][c]

            x[i] = 0
